pendingFingerprintReview.reason: This hook composes one actor/client/entity reserved mail attempt with its read-only recovery and caller-visible status. O204 projects accepted recovery only after the existing exact-token settlement succeeds, and invalidates that projection when scope or token changes, a later local send begins, or recovery fails. A separate stateful recovery owner would split the same reserved identity across competing UI lifetimes.
